## Before you send it

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`; the `dco` check fails otherwise). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/pluries/craticula/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] The title is a conventional commit subject (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `test:`, `refactor:`, `chore:`).
- [ ] A change of behavior updated the spec (`spec/`) and a fixture first.
- [ ] I added or updated a test, and the offline suite passes.
- [ ] I used no real data or credentials anywhere.
